cases.sentence: Тесть, отец ___, убедил его остаться, и он остался у него на три дня, ел, пил и спал там.
cases.explain: «молодой женщины» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

cases.sentence: На четвертый день они встали ___, и он собрался уходить, но отец молодой женщины сказал зятю:
cases.explain: «ранним утром» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

cases.sentence: На четвертый день они встали ранним утром, и он собрался уходить, но отец ___ сказал зятю:
cases.explain: «молодой женщины» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

cases.explain: «молодой женщины» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”

cases.sentence: Утром ___, когда он собрался уходить, отец молодой женщины сказал:
cases.explain: «пятого дня» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

cases.sentence: Утром пятого дня, когда он собрался уходить, отец ___ сказал:
cases.explain: «молодой женщины» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

cases.sentence: А когда этот человек вместе со своей наложницей и слугой встал, чтобы уйти, отец ___ сказал ему:
cases.explain: «молодой женщины» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”
